connector.name: Drillr - The financial MCP for AI agents
connector.registryDescription: The financial MCP for AI agents - 90+ financial tables, SEC filings, signals, alt-data.
connector.summary: Hosted at gateway.drillr.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.drillr, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer drl_*. Get a key at https://drillr.ai/developer/keys?ref=mp_registry
